description: A small white cabinet with two doors sits on a pink cloth in front of a draped backdrop, with the person’s forearms resting near the bottom edge. The right hand reaches forward to the cabinet, pulls the right door open and then the left door open, reaches inside to remove a small green-and-yellow block, sets it down to the right, and then swings both doors shut so the cabinet ends closed; the left hand stays mostly still and does not touch the cabinet.
